tasks.short: Supervise residents and students on the ward, teach at the bedside and in sessions, fill competency assessment forms, and schedule teaching sessions.

steps.what: Hospitalist supervises medical students and residents on the ward
Hospitalist trains residents at the bedside and in teaching sessions
Hospitalist fills competency assessment forms on paper
Hospitalist schedules teaching sessions by e-mail

tasks.design: Residents request a competency assessment in their e-portfolio ({LMS}), which opens the right form on the hospitalist's phone with the resident's details filled in, so paper forms are not filled and handed in. Teaching sessions are scheduled with a shared-calendar poll ({CALENDAR}) instead of e-mail rounds. Supervising and teaching stay with the hospitalist.
tasks.previous_blocker: Assessments were filled on paper and sessions arranged by e-mail.
tasks.enabler_now: E-portfolios open assessment forms on request; calendars run polls.
tasks.still_hard: Assessments are often left until the end of a rotation.
tasks.human_edge: Knowing when a resident is ready to act alone at night.

reach.learn: Whether assessments are recorded on time.

evidence.claim: E-portfolios can open assessment forms on a trainee's request; calendars run scheduling polls.

assumptions: Boundary: from trainees on the ward to sessions scheduled; the training programme is outside.
Input contract: residents use the e-portfolio; fallback is paper.
Supervision and teaching do not change.
Residents request assessments in about the time handing over a form took.
research_questions: Are assessments recorded during the rotation more often?

incremental.description: Hospitalist answers assessment requests on the phone.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: few trainees; high: teaching hospitals with many residents.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The hospitalist keeps supervising and teaching trainees; paper assessments and e-mail scheduling shrink.
role.ambitious_version: A hospitalist with more time to teach.
